title: [RCCL] Strix-Halo tuning
author: PJAvinash
body:
Motivation: performance enhancements primarily for Strix Halo and initialization optimizations in RCCL. Changes include safer topology preset handling, O(nChannel*Ranks) topology post-processing, load-balanced Hamiltonian rings for larger node counts, and gfx1151-isolated tuning.

Test plan: Tested on 1, 2, 3, and 4 nodes in a star-connected topology via Ethernet switch.

Test result: RCCL executes without failures. Performance improvements were minimal on the test system; 10 Gbps links were practically saturating for collectives at larger data sizes. RCCL unit tests for gfx1151 succeeded.
scope_warning: PR-author report; no raw logs preserved in the connector response; topology is Ethernet switch, not Ethernet-over-USB4.
